interpretation.map15_gradient: True AD gradients remain large; eps1e-3 is locally accurate at saved 15-step posterior (relative L2 error 0.165 percent and 0.387 percent). Finite-difference noise does not explain away nonconvergence.
interpretation.line_search_frame37: At repeated MAP80 endpoint, representative GN direction (damping1e-4) is predicted downhill by eps1e-3 FD but uphill by AD and double-model directional derivatives. FD stencils cross LeakyReLU branches.
interpretation.line_search_frame59: At repeated MAP80 endpoint, representative GN direction is true downhill only in a narrow neighborhood; double decreases1e-5/1e-6 while production FP32 objective does not reliably resolve changes of this magnitude.
interpretation.smaller_eps: Blindly lowering FD eps to1e-4 or1e-5 amplifies float32 subtraction error at the saved MAP15 posterior; not a demonstrated repair.
interpretation.scope: Representative directions use damping1e-4; do not claim these are the exact four terminal production directions (damping1e-8..1e-5). No solver change or new sequence outcome demonstrated.
interpretation.next_stage: Only a bounded same-two-frame derivative/solver comparison is justified before any sequence replay; no proposal to add contact or part-specific priors.

protocol.question: Does more reliable same-frame exact-AD double-precision MAP still allow ankle rise?
protocol.input: actual saved prior and full Pqq from motion_chain_snapshots.npz;all original valid pixels
protocol.objective: unchanged raw-fisheye Huber + wholeVPoser + full predicted temporal quadratic
protocol.parameterization: delta=Sx,S=diag(sqrt(diag(Pqq)));full Pqq inverse retained in objective;diagonal scales only permit exact box representation of latent bounds
protocol.bounds: latent remains in original [-6,6];translation/root no extra bounds
protocol.solver: scipy L-BFGS-B;one call per event;double real SMPL-H/VPoser;exact autograd gradient
protocol.controls: existing MAP15 and MAP80 same-event all-observation policies
protocol.stopping: stop after these two calls,including unsuccessful/budget endings;no continuation/sweep/trajectory feedback/sequence replay
protocol.evidence_boundary: engineering objective/height diagnostics only;not physical or independent3D truth
